scientific_question: For the base-promoted N-alkylation of 3-nitro-1H-pyrrole with propargyl bromide in DMF, what computed chemical behavior best describes formation of N-propargyl-3-nitropyrrole, and which computed energetic and structural features support that description?

inputs.content: 3-nitro-1H-pyrrole is the pyrrole substrate for the N-alkylation reaction.
Propargyl bromide is the alkylating reagent used to form N-propargyl-3-nitropyrrole.
The product is N-propargyl-3-nitropyrrole, also named 3-nitro-1-(prop-2-yn-1-yl)-1H-pyrrole.
The reaction is conducted with sodium hydride in N,N-dimethylformamide at room temperature for 24 h.
The isolated product was obtained as light-yellow crystals in 89% yield and characterized by NMR, IR, and LC-MS.
